Name: k
Description: Rate of progression from latent to infectious state; mean latent period 1.9 days.

Name: a_i
Description: Age-specific hospitalization rate for age group i.

Name: p_Hi
Description: Fraction of clinical cases hospitalized for age group i.

Name: c_1
Description: Recovery rate for infectious class; mean infectious period 1.5 days.

Name: c_2
Description: Recovery rate for hospitalized class; mean hospitalized period 1.5 days.

Name: d_i
Description: Influenza mortality rate for age group i.

Name: CFP_i
Description: Case fatality proportion for age group i.

Name: lambda_i
Description: Age-specific force of infection acting on age group i.

Name: b_ij
Description: Transmission rate between age groups i and j.

Name: q
Description: Transmission probability per contact.

Name: c_ij
Description: Age-specific contact rates between age groups i and j.

Name: n(t)
Description: Vaccination rate; vaccination begins t* days after epidemic onset.

Name: t*
Description: Vaccination start time in the adaptive strategy scenarios.

Name: e_i
Description: Age-specific vaccine efficacy.
Value: 77.5% for individuals <65 y; 35% for seniors >65 y

Name: g_i
Description: Rate at which effectively vaccinated individuals become protected; mean 10 days.

Name: R_0
Description: Basic reproduction number used in scenario analyses.
